ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_EMPLOYER_CCD
AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_EMPLOYER AS(
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY EmployerId ORDER BY InsertDttm DESC ) RN, * FROM (
	SELECT
		CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5', BCM.CUST_EMP_NAME),1) AS EmployerId
		,BCM.CUST_EMP_NAME AS EmployerName
		,NULL AS LocationId
		,BCM.CUST_EMP_PHONE AS EmployerTelephoneNumber
		,NULL AS EmployerFaxNumber
		,NULL AS EmployerEmailAddress
		,NULL AS EmployerUsFederalEmployerId
		,NULL AS PartyId
		,NULL AS DunsNumber
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetHeadquarters
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetBranch
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetDivision
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetSubsidiary
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetParent
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetUltimate
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate
		,BCM.CUST_EMP_NATURE AS AnzsicClassCode
		,NULL AS SectorCode
		,NULL AS SicIndustryCode
		,NULL AS SmeClassCode
		,NULL AS Subsector
		,BCM.CUST_EMP_ADDR1 AS EmployerAddress1
		,BCM.CUST_EMP_ADDR2 AS EmployerAddress2
		,BCM.CUST_EMP_ADDR3 AS EmployerAddress3
		,BCM.CUST_EMP_ADDR4 AS EmployerAddress4
		,BCM.CUST_EMP_CITY AS CityId
		,BCM.CUST_EMP_PROVINCE AS StateId
		,BCM.CUST_EMP_ZIP AS ZipCode
		,NULL AS Country
		,NULL AS EmployerCodeOccupationLegal
		,NULL AS BusinessNature
		,NULL AS EmployerAddressLine1
		,NULL AS EmployerAddressLine2
		,NULL AS EmployerAddressLine3
		,NULL AS EmployerAddressLine4
		,BCM.CUST_EMP_CODE AS EmployerCodeTopCompany
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCMD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCMD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCM ON BCMD.CUST_NBR = BCM.CUST_NBR AND BCMD.CUST_STATUS = BCM.CUST_STATUS AND BCM.isLatest = '1'

	UNION
	
	SELECT
		CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5', BCD.CUST_EMP_NAME),1) AS EmployerId
		,BCD.CUST_EMP_NAME AS EmployerName
		,NULL AS LocationId
		,BCD.CUST_EMP_PHONE AS EmployerTelephoneNumber
		,NULL AS EmployerFaxNumber
		,NULL AS EmployerEmailAddress
		,NULL AS EmployerUsFederalEmployerId
		,NULL AS PartyId
		,NULL AS DunsNumber
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetHeadquarters
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetBranch
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetDivision
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetSubsidiary
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetParent
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetUltimate
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate
		,BCD.CUST_EMP_NATURE AS AnzsicClassCode
		,NULL AS SectorCode
		,NULL AS SicIndustryCode
		,NULL AS SmeClassCode
		,NULL AS Subsector
		,BCD.CUST_EMP_ADDR1 AS EmployerAddress1
		,BCD.CUST_EMP_ADDR2 AS EmployerAddress2
		,BCD.CUST_EMP_ADDR3 AS EmployerAddress3
		,BCD.CUST_EMP_ADDR4 AS EmployerAddress4
		,BCD.CUST_EMP_CITY AS CityId
		,BCD.CUST_EMP_PROVINCE AS StateId
		,BCD.CUST_EMP_ZIP AS ZipCode
		,NULL AS Country
		,NULL AS EmployerCodeOccupationLegal
		,NULL AS BusinessNature
		,NULL AS EmployerAddressLine1
		,NULL AS EmployerAddressLine2
		,NULL AS EmployerAddressLine3
		,NULL AS EmployerAddressLine4
		,BCD.CUST_EMP_CODE AS EmployerCodeTopCompany
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD ON BCDD.CUST_NBR = BCD.CUST_NBR AND BCDD.CUST_STATUS = BCD.CUST_STATUS AND BCD.isLatest = '1'
)A
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_EMPLOYER FROM TEMP_BNKM_EMPLOYER WHERE RN = 1;


WITH TEMP_BNKM_EMPLOYER_SRC AS (
    SELECT 
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
		EmployerId
		,EmployerName
		,EmployerTelephoneNumber
		,AnzsicClassCode
		,EmployerAddress1
		,EmployerAddress2
		,EmployerAddress3
		,EmployerAddress4
		,CityId
		,StateId
		,ZipCode
		,EmployerCodeTopCompany)) AS HASHROW
        ,EmployerId
		,financialinstitutionid
		,SourceSystemCode
		,RECORD_STATUS
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_EMPLOYER
    WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_EMPLOYER_TGT AS (
    SELECT  
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
		EmployerId
		,EmployerName
		,EmployerTelephoneNumber
		,AnzsicClassCode
		,EmployerAddress1
		,EmployerAddress2
		,EmployerAddress3
		,EmployerAddress4
		,CityId
		,StateId
		,ZipCode
		,EmployerCodeTopCompany)) AS HASHROW
        ,EmployerId
		,FinancialInstitutionId
		,SourceSystemCode
    FROM BNKM.Employer
	WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_EMPLOYER_DELTA AS (
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.EmployerId,TGT.EmployerId) AS EmployerId
		,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId	
		,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_EMPLOYER_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_EMPLOYER_TGT	TGT
	ON	SRC.EmployerId = TGT.EmployerId
	AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
	AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_EMPLOYER_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_EMPLOYER_DELTA;


UPDATE TGT 
SET

[EmployerId] = SRC.EmployerId
,[EmployerName] = SRC.EmployerName
,[LocationId] = NULL
,[EmployerTelephoneNumber] = SRC.EmployerTelephoneNumber
,[EmployerFaxNumber] = NULL
,[EmployerEmailAddress] = NULL
,[EmployerUsFederalEmployerId] = NULL
,[PartyId] = NULL
,[DunsNumber] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetHeadquarters] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetBranch] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetDivision] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetSubsidiary] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetParent] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetUltimate] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate] = NULL
,[AnzsicClassCode] = SRC.AnzsicClassCode
,[SectorCode] = NULL
,[SicIndustryCode] = NULL
,[SmeClassCode] = NULL
,[Subsector] = NULL
,[EmployerAddress1] = NULL
,[EmployerAddress2] = NULL
,[EmployerAddress3] = NULL
,[EmployerAddress4] = NULL
,[CityId] = SRC.CityId
,[StateId] = SRC.StateId
,[ZipCode] = SRC.ZipCode
,[Country] = SRC.Country
,[EmployerCodeOccupationLegal] = NULL
,[BusinessNature] = NULL
,[EmployerAddressLine1] = SRC.EmployerAddressLine1
,[EmployerAddressLine2] = SRC.EmployerAddressLine2
,[EmployerAddressLine3] = SRC.EmployerAddressLine3
,[EmployerAddressLine4] = SRC.EmployerAddressLine4
,[EmployerCodeTopCompany] = SRC.EmployerCodeTopCompany
,[SourceSystemCode] = 'CCD'
,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,[WorkFlowId] = 0
,[TaskRunId] = 0
,[InsertDttm] = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.Employer TGT 
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_Employer_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.EmployerId = TGT.EmployerId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_Employer SRC ON SRC.EmployerId = TGT.EmployerId  AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD';


INSERT INTO BNKM.Employer (
	[EmployerId]
	,[EmployerName]
	,[LocationId]
	,[EmployerTelephoneNumber]
	,[EmployerFaxNumber]
	,[EmployerEmailAddress]
	,[EmployerUsFederalEmployerId]
	,[PartyId]
	,[DunsNumber]
	,[DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary]
	,[DunBradstreetHeadquarters]
	,[DunBradstreetBranch]
	,[DunBradstreetDivision]
	,[DunBradstreetSubsidiary]
	,[DunBradstreetParent]
	,[DunBradstreetUltimate]
	,[DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate]
	,[AnzsicClassCode]
	,[SectorCode]
	,[SicIndustryCode]
	,[SmeClassCode]
	,[Subsector]
	,[EmployerAddress1]
	,[EmployerAddress2]
	,[EmployerAddress3]
	,[EmployerAddress4]
	,[CityId]
	,[StateId]
	,[ZipCode]
	,[Country]
	,[EmployerCodeOccupationLegal]
	,[BusinessNature]
	,[EmployerAddressLine1]
	,[EmployerAddressLine2]
	,[EmployerAddressLine3]
	,[EmployerAddressLine4]
	,[EmployerCodeTopCompany]
	,[SourceSystemCode]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	[EmployerId]
	,[EmployerName]
	,[LocationId]
	,[EmployerTelephoneNumber]
	,[EmployerFaxNumber]
	,[EmployerEmailAddress]
	,[EmployerUsFederalEmployerId]
	,[PartyId]
	,[DunsNumber]
	,[DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary]
	,[DunBradstreetHeadquarters]
	,[DunBradstreetBranch]
	,[DunBradstreetDivision]
	,[DunBradstreetSubsidiary]
	,[DunBradstreetParent]
	,[DunBradstreetUltimate]
	,[DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate]
	,[AnzsicClassCode]
	,[SectorCode]
	,[SicIndustryCode]
	,[SmeClassCode]
	,[Subsector]
	,[EmployerAddress1]
	,[EmployerAddress2]
	,[EmployerAddress3]
	,[EmployerAddress4]
	,[CityId]
	,[StateId]
	,[ZipCode]
	,[Country]
	,[EmployerCodeOccupationLegal]
	,[BusinessNature]
	,[EmployerAddressLine1]
	,[EmployerAddressLine2]
	,[EmployerAddressLine3]
	,[EmployerAddressLine4]
	,[EmployerCodeTopCompany]
	,[SourceSystemCode]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_EMPLOYER
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_EMPLOYER;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_EMPLOYER_DELTA;

END
